title: passiflora trianae
intro: Passiflora trianae, commonly known as the Triana's passionflower, is a species of flowering plant in the Passifloraceae family. It is a climbing vine that is native to the tropical regions of South America and has been used for its medicinal properties for centuries. The health benefits of Passiflora trianae include its ability to reduce anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative and calming effects, while its therapeutic actions include its use in treating restlessness, irritability, and nervous disorders. The bioactive constituents of Passiflora trianae include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
